title: FN-2187's Plan
description: On board the massive Star Destroyer, FN-2187 removes his helmet and starts packing up his armor and gear. Captain Phasma confronts him: "FN-2187. submit your blaster for inspection." The Stormtrooper hands the blaster to her and salutes. He knows it is only a matter of time until he is punished for disobeying orders during the battle in Tuanul. FN-2187 is ready to leave the First Order behind him but cannot escape on his own.
